## Goal
Show the mobile French navigation drawer OPEN over the Amber learning workspace. Portrait single mobile-web viewport, no phone/browser frame. Use case ui-mockup.

## Context Pointers
Inherit the referenced approved-in-direction Amber interface: neutral light ground, charcoal humanist sans, amber current destination/action, green completed ticks and pale-blue return section. User requires persistent top-left brand slot, top controls and toggled sidebar. This image demonstrates an open narrow-screen sidebar, not another app.

## Constraints
At top, leave an undimmed persistent header with PanelLeftClose icon trigger (outlined rectangle, left divider and LEFT chevron, never hamburger), outlined empty logo square and exact placeholder "Nom de l'app". The branding stays at the SAME top-left location as in a closed drawer layout. Theme control and FR/account may sit on a second compact header row; use familiar readable controls.
Below the persistent header, an open LEFT navigation drawer covers about80% of the content width and extends to the bottom. Remaining20% shows the underlying learning surface dimmed by a neutral scrim. Header background controls other than brand must look inactive; do not draw a focusable control outside the modal state.
Inside the drawer: heading "Navigation", a clear close button "Fermer" with small X icon; ordinary navigation links "Mon apprentissage" (active amber background), "Mes parcours", "Activité". Add a visible keyboard-focus outline to "Fermer" as a proposed interaction state. No extra sidebar destinations, chat, scores or notifications.
Drawer lower area can show "Français" and a labelled "Mode sombre" toggle OFF, with ample spacing. Do not duplicate a second logo/name inside the drawer; the existing header branding remains visible.
Behind the scrim show only fragments of the same learning page, such as "Créer une page web simple" and amber next-action block; no changed samplecounts. This is a static design of a modal navigation overlay, not proof that focus trapping works.
Footer inside drawer "Maquette · Données d'exemple".
Use a restrained border/shadow separating drawer from scrim, no glassblur, no landscape multi-panel sheet, no phone frame. All French copy readable.

## Done When
The mobile image clearly shows open drawer, active destination, close affordance, persistent brand slot and dimmed inactive background; desktop navigation has been adapted for mobile. No functional keyboard/accessibility success claim.
